entries.e7118f4f88a82bcf: Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥35,444 million, up 1.8% from the previous period. The Interior Building Materials Business stayed roughly flat at ¥18,078 million, the Exterior Business rose 4.8% from the previous period to ¥12,895 million in sales, and the Living Environment-Related Business rose 0.2% from the previous period to ¥4,469 million. The Exterior Business is said to have benefited from capturing rush demand ahead of a legal revision and from sales promotion campaigns, while the Living Environment-Related Business is said to have taken the first step toward improvement, supported by an increase in construction orders and other factors.
